messages:
Maya: Quick sync — Parkline pilot case study needs final assets by Friday EOD. Interview is on Wed 10:00am PT. We need a 30m recorded interview, 2-3 pull quotes, a 30s customer clip, logo files, and signed quote release. Can we confirm timeline and legal?
Jorge: On it. I’ll draft the narrative and 2 pull quotes after the interview. Planning a PR-friendly quote + a longer technical quote for the blog. Recording + transcript should be enough for redlines.
Devon: Zoom link created: https://zoom.mock/parkline. Producer checklist: 1) start recording 2) capture gallery + speaker view 3) confirm logo/brand assets 4) note timestamps for clips 5) upload raw recording to GDrive. I’ll share the asset checklist in the channel.
Saad: Looping in legal — need customer's signed release (DocuSign) and confirmation on embargo date. @Maya, please drop the customer contact and DocuSign link. Also quick legal tweak: avoid absolute claims like 'zero downtime' — we prefer 'no observed downtime during test window' or similar.
Maya: DocuSign link sent to Parkline PM this morning: https://docusign.mock/parkline. Customer requested embargo until 2026-04-06. Is that workable for our launch calendar?
Jorge: Embargo to Apr 6 is fine. We can aim to publish Apr 8 and slot a quick webinar Apr 14. Also planning a benchmark narrative: want a headline stat about latency improvement + a short methodology note.
Elliot: I ran the benchmarking suite yesterday. Median p95 latency dropped ~46% across three runs with the new serving profile. Test IDs: run-2026-03-15a/b/c. I’ll upload raw numbers to the shared folder and add a one-line methodology blurb.
Maya: Perfect. Jorge — use Elliot's stat but add the methodology caveat. Saad — once legal approves the exact quote wording we’ll send to the customer for sign-off. Timeline: legal review by Tue EOD, customer approval Wed, publish assets Thu for internal review, press/webinar the following week.
Saad: Reviewing now. Suggestion for the quote: change 'we saw zero downtime' to 'we observed no downtime during the measurement window' and avoid absolute timeframes without data. I’ll provide a redline by noon tomorrow.
Devon: Noted — I’ll update the transcript cue sheet and add clip timestamps for the 30s highlight.
Jorge: Draft of the blog intro + two quote options uploaded: https://docs.mock/parkline-draft. One is customer-facing, one is technical. Also added a CTA for webinar sign-ups that ties to inbound lead routing (cc: growth).
marketing-bot: Reminder: Parkline asset checklist due in 48 hours. :calendar: :bell:
Maya: Thanks everyone — small ask to keep the quote edits tight so we don’t slip the embargo. Ping me if anything blocks legal or customer signature. :white_check_mark:
